title: Vesper and the Terminal
author: Juniper Kavanagh
blurb: Ines Halloran, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
